steps.text: 11:11 A.M   Weather/Drizzle
Outside of Muk Wo Warehouse, Sam Cheong Chai, Central Lungmen

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: The scouting is more or less complete. Our observation spot is stealthy enough, and there's nobody around the warehouse.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Looks like it's an abandoned construction site with piles of construction materials left behind. There are traces of things being dragged around.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Reunion must have set up an ambush here.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ch'en, is Ah Faat your informant?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Yes. Did you overhear our conversation?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I tried my best not to.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'e known him for a long time, more than 10 years. There's no way I wouldn't recognize his voice.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: When did you make him a informant?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: He was infected more than a year ago. At that time, he disappeared from his bar, leaving the glasses he cleaned every day unattended and covered in dust.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Maybe even before that.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You at least should have told me about it.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Looks like it's about to rain. Let's get started and chase the enemies out of their ambush spots.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Sigh...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: We're too late. He's going to bleed out.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'll draw Reunion's fire. The rest of you should seize the opportunity to surround them and end this battle quickly.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Too dangerous.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: But it's the fastest way to win. You can trust me on this one.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I always trust you.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Follow Hoshiguma's instructions. Make it quick.

steps.name: L.G.D. Agent
steps.text: Yessir!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I'm ready, Hoshiguma.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That's more like it. I'm going to flush them out of their ambush spots. Give me three minutes.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Doing all that by yourself in three minutes? That's way too reckless!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If you show any signs of needing help, we're going to attack.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No, just give me my three minutes.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...It's all I'm going to need.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Here we go.
